title: A twelve-bar route
summary: Follow the basic blues chord order.

steps.title: A twelve-bar route
steps.body:
**12-bar blues** means a repeating twelve-bar chord plan. Here use I–I–I–I, IV–IV–I–I, V–IV–I–I, with one chord for each four-count bar.

**Why it matters:** The same twelve-bar map lets players stay together through a whole cycle.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: In G the chords are G–G–G–G, C–C–G–G, D–C–G–G. Repeated chords still get their own place in the app. Count four for each bar yourself; timing is not graded.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: After the last G, begin at the first G again. More blues colours come later; these familiar major shapes teach the route first.
